tools.name: spryng_get_balance
tools.description: Return the credit balance of the Spryng account behind this key.

tools.name: spryng_list_messages
tools.description: List SMS messages sent from this account, newest first by default. Filter by status (pending, sent, delivered, failed), recipient number, originator, reference, created or scheduled date range, or country code.

tools.name: spryng_get_message
tools.description: Return one SMS message by its Spryng id (UUID), including its status when available.

tools.name: spryng_list_subaccounts
tools.description: List the subaccounts of this Spryng account. Filter by active state or a username/email search string.

tools.name: spryng_send_message
tools.description: Send one SMS to up to 50 recipients. Spends credits and cannot be undone once sent. Use scheduled_at to send later (cancel with spryng_cancel_message before it is sent).

tools.name: spryng_cancel_message
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled message before Spryng sends it. A message already sent cannot be cancelled.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spryng_list_messages, spryng_get_message, spryng_list_subaccounts · Public sink: spryng_list_messages, spryng_get_message, spryng_list_subaccounts, spryng_send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spryng_list_messages, spryng_get_message, spryng_list_subaccounts · Public sink: spryng_list_messages, spryng_get_message, spryng_list_subaccounts, spryng_send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
